# Test fixtures

`tdx_quote_td15ex` and `tdx_quote_td15ex_collateral.json` are copied unchanged from
[Phala-Network/dcap-qvl](https://github.com/Phala-Network/dcap-qvl/tree/837e1fc5a176dc6f28923137ae3b99b786bc88cb/sample) (commit `837e1fc5a176dc6f28923137ae3b99b786bc88cb`),
licensed under the MIT License. They are a real Intel TDX 1.5 quote and its collateral, valid at
2026-10-08T02:45:00Z, used to test DCAP verification without network access.
